name: LOLA south-pole candidate point 0E
coordinateSystem: Moon planetocentric latitude; east longitude 0–360 degrees
elevationDefinition: LOLA topography = lunar planetary radius minus the lunar average radius of 1737.4 km; it is relative topography, not an absolute altitude above a separately specified datum.
slopeMethod: Least-squares planar fit to all valid LOLA topography points returned in this 0.01° latitude × 0.1° longitude query window. This slope is derived by this package and is not an official LOLA slope field.
